verdict.rationale: LibreOffice is an office productivity suite whose conversion features cover document, spreadsheet, presentation and graphics formats. Transcoding audio and video with codec, bitrate and resolution control belongs to a media-transcoder product, so this axis does not apply. Nothing in the evidence shows LibreOffice shipping audio or video transcoding.

support.subject: As a power user, audio and video transcode between formats with control over codec, bitrate, and resolution
